authorization_scope: Completed old 50000 corpus only; cid and persisted canonical smiles fields used for exclusion metadata; no labels, activations, v5, or new reserve accessed.
hash_contract: SHA256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the persisted smiles CSV field, with no newline, strip, Unicode normalization, or other transformation; lowercase hexadecimal.

original_standardization.procedure: Original RDKit default parse/sanitize; fragment sanitize; retain largest heavy-atom fragment with first tie retained; RemoveHs; original filters; MolToSmiles defaults and roundtrip checks. No new RDKit execution or charge/tautomer standardization in this export.
